scope: Read-only standard EXIF shooting data in the inspector; synthetic fixtures only, no camera-wide metadata qualification.
exif_tests: TIFF little/big endian, JPEG APP1, PNG eXIf
Missing tags, thumbnail exclusion, duplicate model, zero rational denominator, long strings, truncated/invalid offsets, 4 MiB bound
LensSpecification, ISO overflow and long exposures
Probe, raster and reference mip transport

integration.lifecycle_api: Mach task/audit token + dynamically resolved libproc SPI; no PID-only signal
integration.scope: integrated XPC R0 corpus, two processes, timeout and memory supervision; full sandbox/release gate open

ui.method: Native accessibility tree and screenshot inspection through computer-use; grid and inspector scrolling
ui.missing_tags: Em dash verified on existing synthetic corpus

limitations: Windows native and real-camera corpus not exercised in this increment
Classic TIFF-based RAW standard tags only; no general MakerNote lens identification, BigTIFF metadata or qualified catalog/XMP subsystem
Only first 4 MiB are inspected; malformed or out-of-budget EXIF can leave shooting values absent
Two formats-smoke runs used only for exploratory captures, not counted as completed format campaigns; their DNG/JPEG stages were absent
No R0-R4 or Standard/Reference gate closed
